authority: Existing CommerceKernel scopes, store membership and Permissions.change are the only role/action authority. Agency identity is descriptive metadata, never a global credential.

delegation.actions: Explicit subset of existing role actions and AGENCY_DELEGABLE_ACTIONS; at most 30
delegation.resources: Explicit scoped canonical IDs or null; at most 1000
delegation.protected: Owner/authority, secret/account administration and budget configuration are not delegable
delegation.session_rule: Every regrant revokes previous sessions; new server-issued store session is required

revocation: Clears only the selected store member's canonical permissions and deactivates membership; all its store sessions revoke. Original queued SupportDelivery checks its stored owner_session_hash immediately before native send.
limits: An operation separately owned and approved by another authorized principal is not generically canceled merely because its earlier proposer was revoked.

tests.targeted_fault: Actual grant behavior copies store A role/actions into canonical store B membership; the independently required denied-write oracle fails.
